name: Ifa
notes: KQM's healer build and Game8's swirl build agree: 4pc Viridescent Venerer, EM on sands, goblet and circlet (ER sands as an option, Healing Bonus circlet in KQM), Sunny Morning Sleep-in first. KQM also gives an Anemo DPS build (ATK%, Anemo DMG, CRIT; Viridescent Venerer, Obsidian Codex, Marechaussee Hunter) that is left out because Game8 and the first KQM build treat him as a healer. Talent order: KQM Character Level > Skill > Burst >> Normal Attack, Game8 Skill > Burst > Normal Attack; the card uses Skill > Burst > Normal. His Tonicshot heal scales with EM and the Skill damage with ATK, so the scaling stat is EM. ER 150 is inside KQM's 'Solo Anemo, about 25s rotation' C0 range (135-150) and below its 20-22s range (160-195); neither source gives other goals. Partners: Anemo teammates and Pyro, from KQM's 'Anemo DPS teams' rows and the swirl build.
